name: Senri no Kifu
source:
A mystery and shogi battle game set in the modern world of shogi and featuring seven popular real-life shogi players. 

 “How did the master player disappear?” Set in the modern world of shogi, incidents like this are frequently arising. What is the meaning of the keyword “clairvoyance”? This is a detective mystery game that depicts the profoundness of a gambler, and the pains of a young man aiming to become a professional shogi player. Explore crime scenes, solve mysteries, and figure out the culprit from a unique cast of characters including real-life shogi players.
translation:
一款以现代将棋世界为背景的神秘将棋战斗游戏，其中包括七名受欢迎的现实生活中的将棋玩家。

 “高手怎么消失了？”以现代将棋世界为背景，类似事件屡屡发生。关键词“千里眼”的含义是什么？这是一款描写赌徒的深奥，以及立志成为职业将棋手的年轻人的痛苦的侦探悬疑游戏。探索犯罪现场，解开谜团，并从包括现实生活中的将棋玩家在内的独特角色中找出罪魁祸首。
